environment.description: Same Node.js 18 application deployed on ECS Fargate. PostgreSQL 15 connection configured via AWS Secrets Manager rotation, resolving to role 'svc_migration_reader'. Role provisioned by Terraform module 'rds-iam-auth' with pg_hba.conf entry restricting to md5 auth from specific security group. Database grants applied via: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO svc_migration_reader; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO svc_migration_reader; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM svc_migration_reader; Role has no CREATEROLE or SUPERUSER attributes. pg_catalog and information_schema access retained for ORM introspection compatibility.

config.database_grants: SELECT-only on all tables, explicit REVOKE of INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, no DDL privileges
config.network: private subnet, ALB with cognito auth
